name: denubis-hook-agent-notice-log
description: Logs the first 300 characters of every submitted prompt and every inbound delivery, with its origin, to a JSONL file, changing nothing

log_path.title: Log file
log_path.description: Absolute path of the JSONL log, or one starting with ~/. Leave empty to write agent-notice-log.jsonl in the Claude config directory: $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when set, else ~/.claude.
